subject: Media Literacy
title: Cultural Appropriation in Ads
description: A micro-lesson that makes Cultural Appropriation in Ads usable.

hook.text: Pepsi once aired a commercial where Kendall Jenner solved police brutality by handing a cop a soda.

buildup.text: Brands frequently borrow cultural symbols, movements, and identities to appear relevant and progressive.

discovery.text: This appropriation strips cultural elements of their meaning, reducing activism and identity to aesthetic choices.

twist.text: The same brands that co-opt social movements often lobby against the policies those movements demand.

climax.text: When a brand uses your culture to sell products, it values your aesthetic, not your community.

punchline.text: They borrow the style. They ignore the struggle.

quiz.question: What is cultural appropriation in advertising?
options: Borrowing cultural symbols to seem relevant while ignoring their meaning
